paragraphs.text: Update QCP cloning logic for copying lines and fields in stepped up pricing
As a user, when quoting with stepped up pricing, the cloned lines should have field values that align with business processes - copying values where appropriate and setting others to null.

Stepped up pricing will involve cloning groups of quote lines to represent the years (or other timeframes) of a subscription term. To maintain data integrity and provide a MVP solution, many fields should not be editable in the cloned groups. This ticket provides the requirements for the fields that should be cloned, those that should be made null upon cloning, and which fields the users will be able to edit in the cloned groups.

In addition, we'll align SALDEV-1371 with this ticket -

As a user, when a line is cloned, either for price change or other purposes, the fields that calculate ARR should not be cloned as well. This is currently leading to erroneous data, as discovered on SALDEV-1351
See Sunita's proposed design from SALDEV-1382: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1aARLxpdhEETdCyBgOOt4ZhdjzP8x-4yYY1LjbEiJ5Rs/edit?gid=1836819863#gid=1836819863

-Clone Group button functionality:
By default, clicking the Clone Group button in a quote line group automatically copies all quote lines.

QCP will need to overlay below guardrails:
-- The Opportunity Line Id and NS Id fields:
*****we need to confirm with NS whether these should remain constant across the groups or differ? ***
Current assumption is that Opp Line Id should remain the same but the NS id should not copy. (NS id would be populated on renewal, still TBD how we will address changing non-stepped up pricing contract to stepped-up pricing on amend/renew)

-- For XB and Domestic, all of the attribute field values should all copy to subsequent groups, including Transaction Currency
   -- If the user changes any of these field values in the first group, we will NOT copy those changes forward to the following groups. This is for MVP and may be revised in further enhancements. OK per Kirk

-- Users cannot change any fields on the cloned group lines except for quantity and price-related fields. This means no changes to attribute-related or any other fields in the drawer.

-- Quantity, Quoted Price, Adjusted Rate Amt, Adjusted Rate %, Rate Details -
Though these values are copied they should be editable by users in the subsequent groups.

-- The Ship to Account field should copy to the subsequent groups and should not be editable when cloning groups for stepped up pricing only. (Kirk to confirm ok for MVP)

-- ARR fields -
   -- ARR fields will only be visible in the first group, this includes for multiple XB/DOM lines within the group as it is in the current design. Further cloned groups will NOT have any of those fields visible, and the values from the first group will not copy to subsequent group lines at all.

  -- From SALDEV-1371, ARR fields should be set to null when cloning lines for Non-SUP purposes as well.
   
-- Changes made to fields in one group do NOT automatically update subsequent groups. OK per Kirk
-- Products added in one group do NOT automatically update subsequent groups. OK per Kirk

MV 7/16: Also consider what needs to be updated in the Clone Handler custom script, and what needs to be addressed for the line cloning functionality. See documentation on SALDEV-1384

MV 8/17: Removed reference to amendments, now out of scope for MVP
Updated QCP : QCP_HideFieldInQLE [ I have added the comments with the Jira # on QCP and

Apex Trigger: QuoteLineTrigger [ QuoteLineTriggerHandler.copyOpportunityLineIdOnRamp(Trigger.new)].
Apex Class: QuoteLineTriggerHandler
Apex Test Class: QuoteLineTriggerHandlerTest
When quoting with stepped up pricing -
- You can edit the fields as usual in the first group

- Once the first group is cloned, the values in the drawer for each line copy to the cloned group's lines. But the fields in the drawer of the cloned group are not editable, except for those related to usage prices.
- The Quantity and Quote Price fields are editable on the quote lines.
- The above is true for all further cloned groups/lines
After saving the quote, review the opportunity line ids across the groups. Quote Line 1 in Group 1 should have the same Opp Line Id as Quote Line 1 in Group 2, etc.
- NS Ids are only present if this is an amendment or renewal, and should not change during the quoting process
-Testing should include multiple verticals, quotes with mix of step up pricing groups and non step up, multiple ship to accounts and only 1 ship to account, payments and bundled products.

When quoting for non-stepped up pricing but cloning lines or groups, the values entered for any of the ARR fields noted above are not copied to the cloned lines. This must be checked outside of the QLE on the Quote Line record detail pages, since those fields are hidden on the cloned lines.
